text:
maria: dropped a compact prototype for embeddings + rerank table. moved vector preview to a side-drawer and collapsed export into an action bar. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-proto

ada: nice. accessibility first: drawer must trap focus while open, announce via aria-live, and return focus to triggering element on close. keyboard users need a visible focus target to open the drawer (no hover-only paths).

sam: backend can lazy-load full vectors for the drawer. we'll cache per-session. note: vectors can be large so default table payload will exclude them.

leo: product: default export should be "Export visible results". include a chevron menu for "Export selection" and "Export range". people expect visible by default.

jess: copy tweak: change label to "Attach vector data (JSONL only)" in modal. add tooltip: "Vectors increase file size and may be large." also ensure modal title is an h2.

noah: UI request: show an estimated size when user toggles include-vectors. rough estimate is fine (e.g., "~22 MB"). if >100k rows + vectors, auto-queue and show message.

sam: infra note: streaming cap is 100k rows. queued exports will email a link; API: POST /exports {format,scope,include_vectors,compress}.

jess: accessibility: when export finishes, announce via polite aria-live: "Export ready: 1,234 rows. Press Enter to download." include a keyboard-focusable "Copy download link" button.

ada: vector preview drawer must provide a keyboard shortcut (V) when row focused and an accessible label like "Vector preview for <doc title>". show first 10 dims and a copy button.

maria: UI detail: relevance column should show small heatmap + numeric tooltip for score and delta. color scale: green (+), gray (0), red (-). aria-label example: "Relevance 0.73, change +0.12".

qa-bot: QA checklist: E2E for small export (<=100 rows) validating headers + counts; JSONL validation for vector length; accessibility smoke tests for focus flow, aria-live announcements, and keyboard shortcuts. ticket created: IN-4567.

maria: thanks — i'll update the Figma with these changes and post a follow-up. :thumbsup:
